title: Moving to Canada
text: I will join the University of Saskatchewan as a Postdoctoral Fellow, funded by a Canada Impact+ Research Training Award (CIRTA), to model natural hydrogen generation in iron-bearing minerals.
Poster at ISFOE26, Thessaloniki, on multiscale charge transport in polymer–organometallic hybrid systems.
Presented our multiscale work on molecular interactions in energy optoelectronic materials at IWAM 2026, Ras Al Khaimah Centre for Advanced Materials, UAE.
Joined CaSToRC, The Cyprus Institute, as a postdoctoral research fellow.
Received the Inder Mohan Thapar Research (IMTR) Award for excellence in academic research.
Received my Ph.D. and the Department of Physics Best Ph.D. Thesis Award at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad. Started a postdoc at the Technion, Israel.
Awarded the SERB National Postdoctoral Fellowship, Government of India.
